h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Jaipur

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Jaipur

items.pText: Jaipur's summers are fierce, and from May into June dust storms can sweep in from the desert with little warning. Housing societies, schools, hotels and public gardens across the city still want outdoor play areas that children can use for most of the year. FunPlay Systems designs and builds playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 890 km away, and sends it to Rajasthan by road.

Two things decide whether a play area in Jaipur gets used: shade in the hot months and firm fixing against strong winds. We plan both on the layout drawing. Shade can come from trees, a building, or a gazebo or pergola from our Garden Decor range. Each piece is fixed firmly, grouted into the ground on open sites or self-standing on a prepared base, so a storm cannot shift it.

richText.heading: Shade and wind on an open Jaipur site

c: Plan shade first for the slides and decks, since they take the sun most directly. A pergola over a seating area gives parents a cool place to wait near the play zone. Keep light shade sails away from the play area unless they are engineered for wind, because a dust storm can tear loose fittings. After a storm, sweep sand off slides and decks before children use them, since grit wears the plastic. Rubber flooring is far easier to clear than loose sand.

items.q: How do you fix playground equipment against dust storms?
items.a: On open ground we grout each post into a concrete base, and on paved areas we use a self-standing base suited to the site. Check bolts after strong winds and clean off sand before use.

items.q: Can you supply shade structures with the playground?
items.a: Yes. Our Garden Decor range includes gazebos and pergolas. We place them on the same layout drawing as the play equipment and can send them in the same order.

items.q: Do you supply housing societies in Jaipur?
items.a: Yes. Societies, schools, hotels and public gardens in Jaipur can order from us. We deliver from Vasai by road and install with our own team or a dealer in Rajasthan.
